<function name="Scale" parent="VMatrix" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Scales the matrix by the given vector.

Postmultiplies the matrix by a scaling matrix (A = AS).
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="scale" type="Vector">Vector to scale with matrix with.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
